blocks.text: Broken seasons impose mismatched growth and rest rhythms on digestion.
Location: The Patchwork Prairie of Broken Seasons
Appearance: Sprouts, a tumbling autumn leaf, dry husks and frost appear in the wrong seasonal order. The leaf uses a continuous full-turn rotation.
Care: Use the digestive treatment listed in Care and sensible portions.
Story connection: A communal harvest could reconnect adjoining seasonal plots.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.
